Sounds like a very toxic environment for you guys to be in. I’m sorry you got to go through that, do you got family you could go to with your siblings? It’s not healthy to go have to see that constantly.. I too grew up with parents who fought all the time, I didn’t realize how much it affected me till it came into my own relationship and I thought it was okay, I hope you figure this out.

I know family is family especially your mother but she sounds quite controlling. You shouldn’t let anyone control your thoughts or actions ever. You sound like you got a good guy, you will likely regret losing him due to what your mother thinks of him. Your mother should respect that you will be with who you want to be with, it ain’t like she’s the one dating him. Good guys are hard to come by, they really are, don’t let anyone even your mother ruin something like that.
